problemSignature.symptom: Golden demo docs described the product flow but did not point to exact validated fixture files, replay commands, or dashboard evidence generation.

rootCause: BoardForge product demos can drift into marketing claims unless the demo script anchors every claim to real KiCad/manufacturing artifacts and commands.
fixSummary: Update golden demo, current limitations, and product demo script docs to reference the odd-shape golden fixture, exact evidence files, replay commands, dashboard-data generation, and honest limitations.

conditions: Use when preparing demos, investor/user walkthroughs, or marketing claims
Require real BoardForge manifests before claiming a board is manufacturing-ready

recipe: Name the exact fixture used in the demo.
List the manifest, routeability report, status report, and manufacturing ZIP.
Keep dashboard evidence tied to generated manifest data.
safetyRules: Do not use protected ESC/FC projects in public demo automation.
Do not claim supplier/API verification without provider evidence.
Do not treat quick regression as a full 90-percent proof.

after.demoDocs: specific fixture, artifacts, commands, gates, and limitations

tests: documentation update; verified by file inspection
